sentence_stem: The memoirist's childhood letters survive only in fragments, so
correct_completion: her account of those years must be pieced together from memory.
full_sentence: The memoirist's childhood letters survive only in fragments, so her account of those years must be pieced together from memory.
acceptable_variants: her story of that period has to be reconstructed from recollection.
the earliest years can only be rebuilt from what she remembers.

options.text: the letters were written in a language she never learned.
options.why_wrong: The language of the letters does not follow from their survival in fragments, so 'so' cannot introduce it.

options.text: her account of those years must be pieced together from memory.
the editor cut the first chapter entirely from the final book.
options.why_wrong: An editorial decision is unrelated to the fragmentary survival of the letters.

options.text: she remembers every detail of that summer with perfect clarity.
options.why_wrong: Perfect recall does not follow from the loss of the letters, so the result clause fails.

grammar_focus: Result clause after 'so' expressing the consequence of lost documents for a memoir
explanation: The fragmentary survival of the letters is the cause. The consequence is that the memoirist must reconstruct her early years from memory.
translation: لم تبقَ رسائل الكاتبة من طفولتها إلا أجزاء متفرقة، لذا يجب إعادة تركيب روايتها لتلك السنوات من الذاكرة.
